existingRuntimeTruth.authorityImport: authority set reads opaque bearer from stdin and stores it in exact HTTPS origin + scheme Keychain slot; this is imported/operator-provisioned authority, not issuer acquisition.
existingRuntimeTruth.metadataStatus: authority status returns only presence/origin/scheme metadata; no such command or secret read was run during this inspection.
existingRuntimeTruth.currentAdmission: OpenAPI obtains the bearer before dispatch and RCIR rechecks the current exact-origin token bytes. The granted local scope is the compiled URI/effect; it is not provider RBAC or issuer credential downscoping.
existingRuntimeTruth.OAuthTypes: Existing OAuthAuthorityBinding/OAuthTokenBundle carry issuer/resource/scopes/expiry and Keychain storage, but OpenAPI httpBearer path does not wire them to TokenRequest acquisition. TokenRequest is not an OAuth scope exchange.
existingRuntimeTruth.observer: Host config currently selects same-origin credential-free bounded GET with exact UTF8 text equality. Isolated session intentionally removes ambient cookies/credential storage. Protected Kubernetes JSON readback is unsupported/unverified.
existingRuntimeTruth.TLS: OriginPinnedHTTP and OpenAPI redirect-rejecting delegates use normal trust. Passing a custom URLSession template preserves configuration, not its custom trust delegate. No operator CA-reference hook is present.
existingRuntimeTruth.shape: Current public arguments are string maps; genuine ConfigMap creation has nested metadata/data, and TokenRequest has arrays/integers. Do not stringify them or invent a flat Kubernetes API. Start with supported GET path parameters and opaque JSON response if the actual acquired OpenAPI contract supports it.
existingRuntimeTruth.signer: Existing protected signingKeyFile is provisioned below model; rotation/revocation/public receipt minimisation remain unfinished G3 components.

smallestGenericIncrementProposal.status: DESIGN ONLY; no implementation or frozen live RED yet
smallestGenericIncrementProposal.gateOrdering: Begin live provisioning/integration only after the G2 exact candidate is GREEN/eligible as required by the parent owner.
smallestGenericIncrementProposal.1_transportTrust: Operator pins a public cluster CA through a trusted provisioning channel in owner-only closed host config. Use an exact-origin TLS trust policy with normal hostname/validity evaluation across acquisition, execution, authority issuance and observation; never install global trust or disable TLS validation. The inspected unverified leaf cannot automatically establish trust.
smallestGenericIncrementProposal.2_realContract: Acquire the actual Kubernetes OpenAPI contract through the existing source/resolver path. Determine the real supported namespaced ConfigMap GET and a harmless forbidden GET from discovered actions; record real operation IDs/schema hashes. Do not claim an operator-invented catalog as live schema acquisition.
smallestGenericIncrementProposal.3_managedAuthority: Extend the existing authority store with opaque managed-reference metadata and a host-only acquisition interface. Keep imported legacy credentials working and label them imported. A thin TokenRequest issuer backend uses an operator-provisioned, restricted issuance identity held below the model; request only a selected service-account identity/audience/duration. No arbitrary shell or HTTP tool is exposed.
smallestGenericIncrementProposal.4_issuerRestriction: Provision a separate uniquely owned G3 namespace/account/Role for the required supported read, plus a separately issued get-only observer identity. Provider permissions are enforced by Kubernetes RBAC associated with the subject, not by an OAuth scope field in a TokenRequest JWT. Preserve existing other-owner lab identities and resources.
smallestGenericIncrementProposal.5_admission: Compute requested authority from the compiled contract and host policy after applicable user confirmation. Bind secret-free issuer, subject/service-account UID, intended audience, exact origin, granted permission evidence, returned expirationTimestamp and credential revision to the existing invocation/lease. Revalidate current reference and validity before lease consumption; issuer re-acquisition cannot turn a spent invocation into an automatic effect retry.
smallestGenericIncrementProposal.6_identityTrust: Do not treat decoded JWT fields as authenticated identity. Use trusted issuer TLS response plus independently verified provider identity/TokenReview or a standard JWT implementation with operator-pinned issuer keys. Account for actual returned lifetime and supported revocation semantics. Preserve caller/task ownership separately from remote credential subject.
smallestGenericIncrementProposal.7_observer: Extend host-selected observers deliberately and compatibly with an explicit separate credential reference and bounded JSON projection/predicates. Lower selected actual values to existing CapabilityValue/RCIRVerificationContract; fail closed for unsupported shapes. Bind observation to invocation, resource, generation and time. Maintain isolated no-ambient-secret sessions, redirect rejection and credential-free behavior as default.
smallestGenericIncrementProposal.8_honestOutcome: Missing/401/403 observation remains unverified/unknown, wrong selected JSON value is failed, and an independently verified resource result can succeed. Sign secret-minimised evidence with an operator-provisioned key, verified externally against a separately trusted public key. No full G3 claim until its signer/trust/revocation controls also pass.
